items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we’re in Clearwater Beach for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have a second opportunity to speak with Kenny Davern. [INTERVIEWEE] I’m very pleased indeed.

ctx.x: Marchand, yeah. She was very good. She really knew — it must be a type that a lot of people have for mothers because when he wanted to smother her with a pillow and held it physically, she was on oxygen and they were wheeling her out on a gurney smiling. This © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
is sort of a curious way of answering your question, Monk, about what music did I hear as a kid. I can’t say other than what was on the airwaves.
